items.title: A birational proper morphism onto a Noetherian algebraic space is an isomorphism in codimension one at normal points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a birational proper morphism with reduced source onto a Noetherian algebraic space, the maximal open over which the morphism is an isomorphism contains every point of codimension zero, every codimension one point with normal local ring, and every point with finite fibre and normal local ring (statement lines 373-389). The proof (proof lines 391-416) uses the dense open isomorphism for part (1), reduces part (2) to part (3), makes the morphism finite near the point using the finite fibre hypothesis, and etale localizes to affine schemes to invoke the case of schemes. H2: three parts with four inputs, written out in full.
